build_encoder_decoder_model: build an encoder-decoder model with a pretrained BERT encoder and decoder using build_model
load_saved_model: load a saved model's state dict, tree vocabulary, and args from a directory using load_model
build_decoder_with_cross_attention: build a BERT decoder with cross-attention enabled for tree-to-text or text-to-tree tasks
build_model_with_custom_vocabulary: build a model that adds custom tree tokens to the tokenizer vocabulary via tree_i2w
load_legacy_model: load an old-style model from separate .pth, .pk, and .json files as a fallback
